meta.title: Engage
meta.author: logicoma (the composer is not named in the repository)
meta.description: Engage, an Ableton Live project in the WaveSabre converter test suite, named after logicoma's 2017 intro Engage (http://www.pouet.net/prod.php?which=69658), which the WaveSabre README lists as made with WaveSabre. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: The project was converted to a WaveSabre song (the `synth-mix` layout), then by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects kinds 65-73), then imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns with variants, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat; track names from the original project where it has them). Instruments and effects are the unified equivalents of the WaveSabre devices and sound close to, not identical with, the original (parity target: 1 dB loudness, 3 dB per octave band).

about.style: cinematic demoscene electro house with distorted FM growl basses, acid lines and big-room drops; dark and driving
about.engine: WaveSabre: Falcon, Slaughter, Thunder, Adultery; effects Scissor, Leveller, Crusher, Echo, Smasher, Chamber, Twister, Cathedral
about.description: A beatless, cinematic intro (bars 1-36) of crushed FM plucks, an FM bass, a sampled pad and reverse crashes builds through noise risers into the first drop at bar 37, where kick, backbeat snare, sine sub and the pitch-dropping 'Waaarrp' growl bass take over. Bar 53 adds the broken acid line, congas, a square-wave lead and offbeat stabs; bars 69-84 swap the acid for a 16th-note FM noodle and a filtered growl before the final drop (bars 85-103) brings everything back with 16th 808 hats, then an outro to bar 108. Pitches centre on D (D1 root in the sub and bass, F/D/A plucks), a D-minor feel with menacing G# accents; the synth bus pumps against a sidechain key on every kick.

about.style: low sampled impact with huge reverb
about.engine: WaveSabre Adultery: gm.dls wave 221, low-pass filtered, through Leveller, Smasher and Cathedral reverb
about.description: A single dark boom at bars 1, 29 and 85 marking the intro, the start of the build and the final drop, washed in a near-infinite freeverb.

about.tempo: one hit per 8 bars plus pickup hits
about.engine: WaveSabre Adultery: gm.dls wave 107 with 2-voice unison detune, high-pass filter, short decay to a low sustain
about.description: Crash hits on the 8-bar section downbeats from bar 9 to 103, some with quarter-note pickups; sent heavily to the big reverb bus.

about.engine: WaveSabre Adultery: gm.dls wave 107 played reversed, slow attack, high-pass filtered, 2-voice unison
about.description: A reversed cymbal that sucks into section downbeats (starting around bars 12.7 to 101.7), pairing with Crash Adlt; sent to the big reverb.

about.style: resonant high-passed click in reverb and phaser
about.engine: WaveSabre Adultery: gm.dls wave 446 from a late sample start, short decay, resonant high-pass; Smasher, Leveller, Cathedral, Twister
about.description: A ticking, roomy click through the intro (bars 1-28) whose filter cutoff and EQ high cut are automated to open up the atmosphere.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: noise only, resonant band-pass filter, slow attack; Twister phaser with automated amount
about.description: White-noise whooshes leading into the drops and sections from bar 36.8 to 101.8, the phaser amount automated for a rising sweep; sent to the big reverb.

about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: 2-operator FM, sine-ish carrier, modulator with strong feedback (automated), medium decay; Scissor distortion, Chamber room reverb
about.description: The intro bass (bars 5-28) on D1 moving to A1 and Bb1, the operator feedback and EQ cuts automated to grow brighter as the intro builds.

about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: 2-operator FM, modulator at ratio 10 with fast decay, 5-voice unison; Crusher, Leveller, Echo
about.description: The intro motif from bar 1 to 28: two-voice 8th-note plucks around F4, D4 and A3 outlining D minor, with automated high cut opening across the variants and a light tempo echo.

about.style: distorted FM pluck lead with chorus and delay
about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: 2-operator FM, short percussive envelopes, high operator feedback; Chamber, Scissor distortion, Twister chorus, Echo
about.description: Doubles the HugePluck figure an octave up (F5, D5, A4) from bar 13 to 28, adding a bright, chorused top line to the second half of the intro.

about.style: high FM blip with full-wet delay
about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: 2-operator FM, short decay; Scissor distortion, 100% wet Echo
about.description: Very high pings (A6, D7, A7) echoing through bars 13-35, the level automated; sent to the big reverb for a glittering intro texture.

about.engine: WaveSabre Adultery: gm.dls wave 436, high-pass filter, Smasher
about.description: A shuffling tambourine layer with varied velocities in the groove sections from bar 45 to 102; partly sent to the drum reverb.

about.style: heavily distorted clap in big reverb
about.engine: WaveSabre Adultery: gm.dls wave 194, Scissor at full drive, Cathedral reverb
about.description: Occasional crunchy clap hits and fills from bar 44 to 95, drenched in a large freeverb.

about.engine: WaveSabre Thunder: one GSM 6.10-compressed kick sample; Leveller low boost
about.description: Drives every drop from bar 37 to 103 on all four beats, with occasional pickup variations at the section ends.

about.engine: WaveSabre Adultery: gm.dls wave 105, Scissor distortion, Leveller
about.description: Short offbeat cowbell fills at the end of phrases from bar 39 to 99, sent to the drum reverb.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: noise through a resonant band-pass around 11 kHz, short decay; Crusher, Leveller
about.description: The classic house offbeat open hat from bar 45 to 102, in the drop and groove sections, lightly sent to the drum reverb.

about.engine: WaveSabre Adultery: gm.dls wave 19, high-pass filter, short release, light Scissor drive
about.description: Rapid 16th-note closed hats that only appear in the final drop (bars 87-102) to lift the energy.

about.engine: WaveSabre Adultery: gm.dls wave 19 pitched down, long decay; Crusher, Leveller, Scissor, Twister phaser, Leveller
about.description: A gritty, phased hat texture in 2-bar runs during the groove sections from bar 45 to 102, lightly sent to the drum reverb.

about.engine: WaveSabre Thunder: one GSM 6.10-compressed snare sample; Leveller mid/high shaping
about.description: The backbeat of every drop from bar 37 to 103 with fills at phrase ends; sent to the Snare Verb bus.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: noise through a band-pass around 6.7 kHz, medium decay; Chamber room
about.description: A noise layer doubling the snare backbeat (bars 37-103) to give it a bright, roomy tail.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: noise through a resonant band-pass with automated cutoff, slow attack; Echo, Chamber
about.description: Rhythmic noise swells whose band-pass sweeps up across 2-bar phrases in the drops (bars 37-101), adding air and tension.

about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: 2-operator FM with high non-integer ratios (28 and 22.37) and feedback, slow attack, pitch envelope; Leveller, Twister
about.description: A metallic fly-by played on a very low note at bars 50, 65, 81 and 97, the EQ low and high cuts automated to sweep it; sent to the big reverb.

about.style: detuned sampled pad with heavy phaser and delay
about.engine: WaveSabre Adultery: gm.dls wave 389 with 2-voice unison detune, slow attack and release; Twister, Leveller, Echo
about.description: Four-voice chords on D, A and Bb from bar 13 to 29 underpinning the intro, the phaser, EQ cuts and delay mix all automated as it swells into the build.

about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: carrier-only sine with no modulation, short release; Smasher
about.description: The low end of every drop from bar 37 to 104, rooted on D1 and moving to G#1, D2 and F2 in 2-bar patterns; transpose automated for shifts, ducked by the Main Duck sidechain.

about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: 2-operator FM, modulator at ratio 16 with very high feedback and a fast pitch/modulation envelope; Crusher, Smasher, Leveller, Twister
about.description: A broken, off-beat acid riff on D1, G#1 and D2 in bars 53-68 and 85-102; the crusher rate, phaser and transpose are automated.

about.style: saw support layer for the acid line
about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: single saw oscillator through a low-pass filter with a short envelope
about.description: Plays the same notes as Broke Acid (bars 53-68 and 85-102) to give it a solid saw body.

about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: 2-operator FM with feedback, 2-voice unison, LFO vibrato and a pitch envelope for the 'waaarp' drop; stacked Scissor/foldover distortions, Leveller, short Echo
about.description: The main drop bass from bar 37 to 68 and 85 to 103, mostly on D1 with F2, D2 and G#2 jumps; EQ, modulation and transpose automated, sent to the room reverb and ducked by the sidechain.

about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: same growl patch as Waaarrp Main with an extra automated low-cut/high-cut Leveller
about.description: Replaces the main growl in the middle section (bars 69-84) on D1 and A#1, its EQ band narrowing at the end to lead into the final drop.

about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: the growl patch played high (A4) with a long decay; Scissor stack, Echo, automated Crusher and level
about.description: Single 'waaarp' shots ending phrases from bar 38.8 to 108, including the last notes of the outro.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: noise through a resonant high-pass with automated cutoff; Scissor foldover, Twister, Leveller
about.description: A noise tail layered under the Waaarrp shots (bars 38.8-100.8) acting as their own fake reverb; sent to the big reverb.

about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: growl patch with carrier ratio 13 and a slow-attack modulator; Twister, Scissor, Leveller, Scissor
about.description: Eight off-beat C#2 hits between bars 40 and 99 that punctuate phrase ends; lightly sent to the big reverb.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: two detuned pulse oscillators with 2-voice unison, open filter, LFO vibrato; Echo, Leveller
about.description: A high, nagging D6/D#6 semitone figure over the groove sections (bars 53-68 and 87-101), echoed and sent to the big reverb.

about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: 2-operator FM with ratios 8 and 3, 2-voice detuned unison; Crusher, Scissor foldover, Chamber, Smasher
about.description: A gritty D3 stab answering the bass on the off-16ths in bars 53-68 and 85-102.

about.style: blippy FM sequence with pitch envelope
about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: 2-operator FM, modulator ratio 33 (automated) with feedback, fast pitch envelope; Scissor, Leveller, Echo
about.description: Busy 16th-note figures on D2, A2 and D3 that carry the middle section (bars 69-84), with the operator ratio and EQ cuts automated; sent to the big reverb.

about.style: falling saw sweep in big reverb
about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: two saw/pulse oscillators with unison, high-pass filter, slow attack, transpose automated downward; Chamber, Echo, Scissor
about.description: Long downward pitch sweeps at section changes from bar 9 to 67, smeared by a full-wet room and a delay whose mix is automated.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: two saw oscillators with 3-voice unison, LFO and envelope modulation, transpose and level automated; Echo, Chamber, Smasher
about.description: A repeated D6 zap whose pitch is automated upward to build tension in the groove sections (bars 45-68 and 87-102).

about.engine: WaveSabre Adultery: gm.dls wave 193, Scissor distortion, Leveller with automated level
about.description: A dense, off-grid conga groove with dynamic velocities from bar 53 to 102; partly sent to the drum reverb.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: noise with a short decay, used only as a trigger
about.description: Follows the kick from bar 37 to 103 and feeds the [Main Duck] compressor's sidechain input to pump the synth bus.

about.engine: WaveSabre Adultery: gm.dls wave 273 with wide 2-voice unison detune, low-pass filter, long decay; Leveller
about.description: A shimmering ride pattern over the drops from bar 37 to 102, sent to the room reverb and ducked by the sidechain.

about.engine: WaveSabre Cathedral: freeverb, room size 0.945, light damping, low cut
about.description: The main long reverb send for crashes, risers, pad, plucks, FX shots and lead; ducked by [Main Duck].

about.engine: WaveSabre Cathedral: freeverb, room size 0.67, low cut
about.description: Short room for Broke Acid, Waaarrp Main and Main Ride; ducked by [Main Duck].

about.engine: WaveSabre Smasher: compressor keyed from Chain Key, fast attack, medium release
about.description: Sums all synths, the ride and the two reverb buses and ducks them on each kick-aligned Chain Key hit for the electro-house pump.

about.engine: WaveSabre Cathedral: freeverb, room size 0.895, strong low cut
about.description: Reverb send for tambourine, conga, cowbell and the open hats, outside the sidechain duck.

about.engine: WaveSabre Leveller into Cathedral: freeverb, room size 0.93, low wet mix
about.description: Gives the Thunder snare its tail; the input level and wet mix are automated to open the reverb at chosen moments.
